import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Cardinality
import Mathlib.RingTheory.AlgebraicIndependent.TranscendenceBasis
import Mathlib.RingTheory.AlgebraicIndependent.Transcendental
import Mathlib.SetTheory.Cardinal.Finsupp
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

noncomputable section
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NonCalkinAlgebra
open Cardinal

/- The root-counting argument is the specialization to small types and
   real extensions of Mathlib.RingTheory.Algebraic.Cardinality at the
   workspace pin (Chris Hughes, Apache-2.0). -/
private theorem real_card_le_of_algebraic (R : Type) [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R]
    [Algebra R ℝ] [NoZeroSMulDivisors R ℝ] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic R ℝ] :
    Cardinal.mk ℝ ≤ max (Cardinal.mk R) Cardinal.aleph0 := by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ x : ℝ, ∃ p : Polynomial R, p ≠ 0 ∧ Polynomial.aeval x p = 0 :=
    fun x => Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isAlgebraic x
  choose p hp hpzero using hex
  have hroot : ∀ x : ℝ, x ∈ (p x).aroots ℝ := by
    intro x
    have hn := (Polynomial.map_ne_zero_iff
      (FaithfulSMul.algebraMap_injective R ℝ)).2 (hp x)
    rw [Polynomial.mem_roots hn, Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_map,
      ← Polynomial.aeval_def]
    exact hpzero x
  let f (x : ℝ) : Σ p : Polynomial R, {y : ℝ // y ∈ p.aroots ℝ} :=
    ⟨p x, x, hroot x⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := fun _ _ h =>
    congrArg (fun t : Σ p : Polynomial R, {y : ℝ // y ∈ p.aroots ℝ} => t.2.val) h
  let κ := max (Cardinal.mk R) Cardinal.aleph0
  have hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ := le_max_right _ _
  have hpoly : Cardinal.mk (Polynomial R) ≤ κ := by
    calc
      _ ≤ Cardinal.mk (ℕ →₀ R) :=
        Cardinal.mk_le_of_injective (f := Polynomial.toFinsupp) Polynomial.toFinsupp_injective
      _ = κ := by rw [Cardinal.mk_finsupp_of_infinite, Cardinal.mk_nat, max_comm]
  calc
    _ ≤ Cardinal.mk (Σ p : Polynomial R, {y : ℝ // y ∈ p.aroots ℝ}) :=
      Cardinal.mk_le_of_injective hf
    _ = Cardinal.sum (fun p : Polynomial R =>
        Cardinal.mk {y : ℝ // y ∈ p.aroots ℝ}) := Cardinal.mk_sigma _
    _ ≤ Cardinal.sum (fun _ : Polynomial R => κ) := by
      apply Cardinal.sum_le_sum
      intro p
      exact (Cardinal.mk_le_aleph0 (α := {y : ℝ // y ∈ p.aroots ℝ})).trans hκ
    _ = Cardinal.mk (Polynomial R) * κ := Cardinal.sum_const' _ _
    _ ≤ κ * κ := mul_le_mul' hpoly le_rfl
    _ = κ := Cardinal.mul_eq_self hκ

private theorem real_basis_card {J : Type} {x : J → ℝ} (hx : IsTranscendenceBasis ℚ x) :
    Cardinal.mk J = Cardinal.continuum := by
  classical
  let K := Algebra.adjoin ℚ (Set.range x)
  letI : Algebra.IsAlgebraic K ℝ := hx.isAlgebraic
  let κ := max (Cardinal.mk J) Cardinal.aleph0
  have hmon : Cardinal.mk (J →₀ ℕ) ≤ κ := by
    by_cases h : Nonempty J
    · letI := h
      exact (Cardinal.mk_finsupp_nat J).le
    · letI : IsEmpty J := not_nonempty_iff.mp h
      exact Cardinal.mk_le_aleph0.trans (le_max_right _ _)
  have hK : Cardinal.mk K ≤ κ := by
    have he : Cardinal.mk (MvPolynomial J ℚ) = Cardinal.mk K :=
      Cardinal.mk_congr hx.1.aevalEquiv.toEquiv
    rw [← he]
    change Cardinal.mk ((J →₀ ℕ) →₀ ℚ) ≤ κ
    rw [Cardinal.mk_finsupp_of_infinite']
    exact max_le hmon (Cardinal.mk_le_aleph0.trans (le_max_right _ _))
  have hr := (real_card_le_of_algebraic K).trans (max_le hK (le_max_right _ _))
  rw [Cardinal.mk_real] at hr
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [← Cardinal.mk_real]
    exact Cardinal.mk_le_of_injective hx.1.injective
  · by_contra! hsmall
    exact (not_le_of_gt (max_lt hsmall Cardinal.aleph0_lt_continuum)) hr

/-- A continuum of parameters in the open unit interval, each excluded
from the rational algebra generated by any subfamily that omits it. -/
theorem exists_independent_trace_parameters :
    ∃ (J : Type) (θ : J → ℝ), Cardinal.mk J = Cardinal.continuum ∧
      (∀ i, 0 < θ i ∧ θ i < 1) ∧
      ∀ (S : Set J) i, θ i ∈ Algebra.adjoin ℚ (θ '' S) ↔ i ∈ S := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨J, x, hx⟩ := exists_isTranscendenceBasis' ℚ ℝ
  have hex : ∀ i, ∃ n : ℕ, |x i| < (n : ℝ) := fun i => exists_nat_gt |x i|
  choose n hn using hex
  let d (i : J) : ℕ := 2 * n i + 1
  let θ (i : J) : ℝ := (x i + (n i : ℝ)) / (d i : ℝ)
  have hd (i : J) : 0 < (d i : ℝ) := by dsimp [d]; positivity
  refine ⟨J, θ, real_basis_card hx, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := abs_lt.mp (hn i)
    refine ⟨div_pos (by linarith) (hd i), (div_lt_iff₀ (hd i)).2 ?_⟩
    dsimp [d]
    push_cast
    linarith
  · intro S i
    constructor
    · intro hθ
      by_contra hi
      let K := Algebra.adjoin ℚ (x '' ({i}ᶜ : Set J))
      have htrans : Transcendental K (x i) :=
        ((AlgebraicIndependent.iff_transcendental_adjoin_image i).mp hx.1).2
      have hsub : Algebra.adjoin ℚ (θ '' S) ≤ K := by
        apply Algebra.adjoin_le
        rintro _ ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
        have hji : j ≠ i := fun h => hi (h ▸ hj)
        have hxj : x j ∈ K := Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨j, by simpa using hji, rfl⟩
        have hnK : (n j : ℝ) ∈ K := by
          exact_mod_cast K.algebraMap_mem (n j : ℚ)
        have hdK : ((d j : ℝ)⁻¹) ∈ K := by
          simpa using K.algebraMap_mem ((d j : ℚ)⁻¹)
        change (x j + (n j : ℝ)) / (d j : ℝ) ∈ K
        rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
        exact K.mul_mem (K.add_mem hxj hnK) hdK
      have hdK : (d i : ℝ) ∈ K := by exact_mod_cast K.algebraMap_mem (d i : ℚ)
      have hnK : (n i : ℝ) ∈ K := by exact_mod_cast K.algebraMap_mem (n i : ℚ)
      have heq : (d i : ℝ) * θ i - (n i : ℝ) = x i := by
        dsimp only [θ]
        rw [mul_comm, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (hd i))]
        ring
      have hxK : x i ∈ K := heq ▸ K.sub_mem (K.mul_mem hdK (hsub hθ)) hnK
      exact htrans (isAlgebraic_algebraMap (R := K) (A := ℝ) ⟨x i, hxK⟩)
    · intro hi
      exact Algebra.subset_adjoin ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

end NonCalkinAlgebra
